name: dot_phrases
description: Providers type a short code like .metf500 in a note's text box and it is replaced with saved text after the command saves. A chart panel lists, inserts, and manages phrases, and an admin app manages practice phrases, practice info, and import.

protocols.description: Replaces dot codes with phrase text after a supported command saves, filling patient and practice placeholders.
Keeps a command from being recorded while a dot code, [bracket], unfilled placeholder, or *** is left in its text.
Note-header button that opens the Dot Phrases chart panel.
Serves the chart panel and admin app, and the phrase API behind them.

handlers.description: App drawer icon for practice phrases, practice settings, and import, shown only to members of the ADMIN_TEAM team.
